summary: Vehicle ID the relation is pinned to; mandatory for type=pinned.
range: String vehicle id. Required when type=pinned. A vehicle can't be reused across relations.
constraints: Same vehicle can't appear in more than one relation.
businessRules: vehicle defines: Specifies the ID of the vehicle that would fulfill the steps. This field is mandatory when using type = pinned. Providing the same vehicle ID to multiple ‘relations’ is prohibited. The vehicle ID p…
Must stay consistent with: relations.type. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: pinned relation binding tasks to V1.
Negative: two relations pinning the same vehicle -> 400.
Interaction: Negative: relation type 'sequence' with steps=[{type: 'job', id: 'J999'}] but J999 does not exist in jobs -> HTTP 400.
Interaction: Negative: relation type 'pinned' with vehicle='V999' but V999 not in vehicles -> HTTP 400.
Interaction: Positive: relation type 'sequence' with steps=[{type: 'job', id: 'J1'}, {type: 'delivery', id: 'S1'}] where both ids exist -> accepted.
Interaction: Negative: relation type 'pinned' with vehicle='V1' appears twice (two different relations) -> HTTP 400 (duplicate pinning).
